shared_elements: low-relief carving on a flat panel
figures with arms extended toward a central element
justification: Both show low-relief profile human figures arranged in horizontal registers, but that is a very generic correspondence: A depicts a large naturalistic two-humped camel led by a single attendant, framed above and below by bands of rosettes, while B shows a small figured scene with radiating rays over figures with raised arms, surmounting many dense lines of script-like signs occupying most of the surface. There is no shared distinctive motif — no animal, no rosette band in B, and no writing or radiating disc in A.
